title: Inference in dynamic models for panel data using the moving block bootstrap
abstract: arXiv:2502.08311v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Inference in linear panel data models is complicated by the presence of fixed effects when (some of) the regressors are not strictly exogenous. Under asymptotics where the number of cross-sectional observations and time periods grow at the same rate, the within-group estimator is consistent but its limit distribution features a bias term. In this paper we show that a panel version of the moving block bootstrap, where blocks of adjacent cross-sections are resampled with replacement, replicates the limit distribution of the within-group estimator. Confidence ellipsoids and hypothesis tests based on the reverse-percentile bootstrap are thus asymptotically valid without the need to take the presence of bias into account.

translated_title: 使用移动块自助法对面板数据动态模型进行推断
translated_abstract: 当回归变量（部分）不严格外生时，线性面板数据模型的推断会因固定效应的存在而变得复杂。在横截面观测数量与时间期数以相同速度增长的渐近框架下，组内估计量是一致的，但其极限分布中包含一个偏差项。本文证明了一种面板版本的移动块自助法——即对相邻横截面的块进行有放回重抽样——能够复制组内估计量的极限分布。因此，基于反百分位自助法的置信椭球和假设检验在渐近意义上是有效的，而无需考虑偏差的存在。
tldr: 本文提出一种对相邻横截面块进行有放回重抽样的面板移动块自助法，能够复制含偏差项的组内估计量极限分布，使基于反百分位自助法的置信椭球和假设检验在渐近上有效，且无需显式修正偏差。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that a panel version of the moving block bootstrap, which resamples blocks of adjacent cross-sections with replacement, replicates the limit distribution of the within-group estimator, thereby making reverse-percentile-based confidence ellipsoids and hypothesis tests asymptotically valid without explicit bias correction.
